title: numericSelector cssClasses option for root applies to a parent div as well as the child <select>
body:
```js search.addWidget( instantsearch.widgets.numericSelector({ container: '#numericSelector', attributeName: 'thing.id', options: [{label: 'name of thing', value: 1}], cssClasses: { root: 'form-control' } }) ); ``` outputs the following HTML: ```html
``` According to the documentation, it should only be applied to the select element. This is problematic in this scenario because I am using with bootstrap and it is making the output undesirable
